text:
jonah: Heads-up — after the base-image rebase (PR #8241) a subset of services fail at startup when the KMS agent can't fetch the signing key. Seen in staging, 3/8 nodes.

tara: ah, saw that too. error in logs: `failed to fetch key: AccessDenied` then container exits.

kevin: is this the cosign key change from last week? did the RBAC tweak land?

lina: yes, I pushed the rbac change to restrict `image-signer` to the signing cluster only. looks like kubelet/service-account on staging didn't get the new rolebinding.

jonah: ok — two things we need immediately: 1) a rollback plan if more services are affected, 2) short-lived mitigation (allowlist staging node SA) so KMS calls succeed.

tara: for mitigation I can add a temporary rolebinding: `kubectl create rolebinding staging-image-signer --clusterrole=image-signer --serviceaccount=staging:default` — will that unblock?

kevin: should work. also we should enable additional audit logs so we can see which SA is being denied. Put `AUDIT_SINK=enabled` for the signing-pod and forward to Splunk.

lina: creating RBAC patch now, will annotate it with `#temp-until-2860001125` and add an expiry. Also adding cosign KMS error telemetry to the stackdriver logs.

jonah: thanks. tara, can you also look at whether this affects image verification path? we don't want unsigned images to be accepted on rollback.

tara: checked — verification uses verifier key in KMS and falls back to local cache. If verifier can't fetch key it should fail-fast. The problem is the signer step failing meaning images didn't get signed before push. So rollback of rebase must avoid promoting unsigned images.

kevin: propose we hold the rebase cutover and roll back nodes to previous base for any prod-serving groups until we confirm key access. I'll open a controlled rollback run: `./infra/rollbacks/rollback_base.sh --group=staging --image=sha256:abcd1234`

jonah: good. I'll open incident in #incidents and loop in ent sec. incident-bot: please create incident for "base-image sign failure — KMS access denied" and tag P1?

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0487 — "base-image sign failure — KMS access denied". Pager duty notified.

lina: quick note— could be related to KMS key policy that denies calls from service account token audiences after the recent KMS migration. I'll verify KMS IAM bindings and cosign KMS signer configuration.

tara: also triaging vuln side: CVE-2025-9876 surfaced in a new layer; if we rollback we should ensure the older base doesn't reintroduce other issues. I'll run a vuln scan on the rollback image and post results.

kevin: action items: tara (mitigation RBAC + vuln scan), lina (KMS IAM & cosign config), jonah (coordinate rollback & incident comms). I'll hold on promoting anything.

jonah: ETA for rollback plan 15m, vuln scan 25m. tagging @security-sig for visibility. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze enforced for images referencing image-signer until INC-2026-0487 is resolved.

tara: temp RBAC patch applied to staging — verified service starts. sending logs to Splunk now.

lina: KMS bindings looked odd — the migration removed the `iam:serviceAccount` principal for the staging SA. Re-adding now, will also rotate the cosign key with short window so old tokens remain valid for 10m.

jonah: great, keep updates here. once we confirm signer can fetch key and staging runs green we'll decide promote/rollback.

kevin: documenting rollback commands and checklist in the incident ticket — will link when done.

tara: vuln scan complete: rollback image OK, found only low severity libssl finding (CVSS 4.2).

jonah: thanks — closing loop: rollback deferred, mitigation applied, KMS IAM fix deployed. follow-up: create a postmortem and add an explicit pre-cutover RBAC and KMS validation step to the base-image release checklist.

lina: filing follow-up PR for checklist items and automated KMS sanity check in CI.

jonah: :thumbsup:
